title: Yellow Radiants
subtitle: Fancy Yellow radiants, framed in white to read at full saturation.

stone.origin: The radiant cut concentrates saturation. Its cropped corners and facet pattern hold Fancy Yellow color deeper and more fully than most other forms — the warmth reads at once rather than building. The baguette halo was designed to amplify that reading: white baguettes at the perimeter create a clean frame of contrast so the yellow at center presents its full saturation without interruption.

metal: platinum and yellow gold The radiant cut concentrates saturation
description: The radiant cut concentrates colour — its cropped corners and dense facet pattern hold Fancy Yellow deeper and more fully than most other forms, so the warmth reads all at once rather than building slowly. Around each stone a halo of white baguettes was set to amplify that reading, a clean frame of contrast that pushes the yellow forward at its full strength. As earrings they swing with the head, the colour catching and releasing at the jawline. Set in platinum and yellow gold, one temperature framing the other.
